name: Autuskey Bulk Upload
author: Autuskey

sections.description:
Autuskey Bulk Upload offers the simplest and most efficient solution for bulk upload WooCommerce products. Forget tedious individual product entries.

This plugin provides a clean and intuitive interface, allowing you to upload multiple products from a single page. Thus, saving you significant time and effort whether you’re launching a new store or managing an existing catalog. It’s the hassle-free way to handle your WooCommerce CSV product importer needs and beyond.

Features:

  • Upload multiple WooCommerce products from a single page.
  • Bulk upload support for simple product types.
  • Intuitive dashboard – no complex setup needed.
  • Supports all essential WooCommerce product fields.
  • Compatible with the latest versions of WordPress and WooCommerce.
  • Lightweight and fast – no performance issues.

Save hours of manual product entry and simplify store management with Autuskey Bulk Upload.

Benefits:

  • Significant Time Savings: Eliminate the tedious process of adding products individually, freeing up valuable time.
  • Effortless Bulk Upload: Upload multiple WooCommerce products simultaneously from a single, user-friendly page.
  • Simplified Store Management: Streamline your workflow for both new store setups and ongoing product catalog maintenance.
  • Intuitive and Easy to Use: No complex configurations or technical expertise required with the clean dashboard.
  • Comprehensive Product Field Support: Includes all essential WooCommerce fields for accurate product information.
  • Guaranteed Compatibility: Works seamlessly with the latest versions of WordPress and WooCommerce.
  • Lightweight and Fast Performance: Ensures your website remains speedy and efficient without plugin-related slowdowns.

How does it work?

Autuskey Bulk Upload provides a user-friendly interface where you can easily input or import your product data. While currently focused on simple product types, it allows for the quick population of crucial details for numerous items at once.

Think of it as your efficient WooCommerce CSV product importer alternative, offering a direct, in-platform experience. For instance, if you’re launching a clothing store with multiple t-shirt variations or managing a bookstore with hundreds of titles, this plugin drastically reduces the time spent on initial setup or adding new inventory.

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Upload the downloaded zip file and click Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  6. Navigate to Bulk Product Uploader in the admin menu to start uploading multiple products.
sections.faq:
What is the best way to bulk upload products to WooCommerce?

Many users look for the most efficient method. The answer often involves using a plugin like Autuskey Bulk Upload or the built-in CSV importer.

Can I bulk upload product images in WooCommerce?

Image handling is a common concern. Yes, plugins and the importer typically support this, often via URLs or by uploading images to the media library beforehand.

How do I bulk update existing WooCommerce products?

Users often need to make changes to their catalog in bulk. This can also be done using import/export tools or dedicated bulk editing plugins.

What is the WooCommerce CSV format for product import?

Understanding the required CSV structure is crucial for successful imports. WooCommerce provides a sample CSV file as a guideline.

Is there a limit to how many products I can bulk upload to WooCommerce?

While WooCommerce itself can handle many products, server limitations (like upload size and execution time) might affect the number you can upload at once.

Can I bulk upload variable products in WooCommerce?

Yes, but it’s more complex than simple products and requires a specific CSV structure or more advanced plugin features. Autuskey Bulk Upload currently supports simple products, with variable product support planned for future updates.

What if my bulk product upload fails in WooCommerce?

Troubleshooting import errors is a common issue. Reasons can include incorrect CSV formatting, missing data, or server limitations.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Upload multiple WooCommerce simple products from one page.
  • Clean and user-friendly interface.

1.0.1

  • Admin UI refreshed: updated layout and styles for the Bulk Product Uploader to improve clarity and match modern admin form patterns.
  • All plugin styles and scripts scoped to the .abu-admin container to avoid affecting other admin pages. See css/bulk-upload.css and js/bulk-upload.js.
  • Improved form controls: taller inputs, refined padding, placeholders and focus states for better usability.
  • SKU and Stock fields are placed side-by-side beneath the product name to reduce vertical spacing.
  • Images dropzone styling and thumbnail presentation improved for a cleaner upload experience.
  • Accessibility fixes: labels now have matching for attributes and input ids are regenerated when cloning product blocks.
  • Subcategory loading now uses WordPress AJAX (admin-ajax.php) with nonce checks to reliably populate dependent category selects.
  • Minor bug fixes and layout resilience updates so sections collapse gracefully when optional fields are disabled.
